Chisimu Uwwe tujitulwisye jalakwe (Qur'aniji) m’Chilo Chakuchimbichika.
Ana ni chichi champaka chimmanyisye ya Chilo Chakuchimbichika?
Chilo Chakuchimbichikachi chiŵele chambone nnope kupunda myesi jakwana sausande (1000).[1]
[1] (97:3) Myesi sausande ikwana yaka 83 ni myesi 4.
Achimalaika akasatulukaga pamo ni Nsimu (Jibulilu) mu Chele (Chilochi) kwa lisosa lya M’mbuje gwao, kwisa kulondesya chindu chilichose (pakuchiŵika mu mpango wakwe).[2]

[2] (97:4) “Mu chele (chilochi) chikasaŵichidwaga m’mangwakwe chindu chilichose chalunda lwakusokoka.” (44:4) Ichindu yalunda lwakusokoka yakwe mpela: kupagwa kwa ŵandu kwisa soni iwumbe yakulekanganalekangana, kuwa kwao, kupedwa malisiki, kupedwa makungu ni ine yosope yakwapata achiiwumbe mu chaka chosope chachikwika, mpela muŵapanjiile Allah kalakala.

[3] (97:5) Akusimulila Ȃishah رضي الله عنه yanti: Ntenga jwa Allah ﷺ jwatite: “N’jisosejesoseje Lailatul Qadr mu ilo ya chiŵalanjilo changakomboleka gaŵa ni 2 ni ngasigala kakusigala (mpela ilo ya 21, 23, 25, 27 ni 29), mu ilo likumi yambesi yamwesi wa Ramadhan.” (Swahîh Al-Bukhârî, Hadith No. 1913.
